description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!   
At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.   
 Job Description: 
 Parsons is looking for a hands-on Cloud Data Engineer to join our team supporting mission-critical cloud, data, and AI-enabling technology initiatives. This position is open to candidates at multiple experience levels, from mid-career to senior. You'll help design and support cloud-based data pipelines, APIs, and modern data platforms that power advanced analytics and automation for mission-focused programs.
 
 This is an implementation-focused role — not a traditional architecture or systems engineering position. We need someone who enjoys building, integrating, and troubleshooting real working systems.
 
 What You'll Do:
 Design, build, test, and support cloud-based data engineering solutions
 Develop and maintain ETL pipelines and data workflows
 Integrate data sources, APIs, applications, and distributed cloud services
 Build and support data processing pipelines, database applications, and data services
 Handle data movement, transformation, validation, and operational readiness tasks
 Develop or integrate RESTful APIs and data-driven applications as needed
 Partner with cloud platform, engineering, and DevSecOps teams on deployment
 Use Git-based version control and CI/CD tooling (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)
 Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, testing, debugging, and documentation
 Support deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting in Linux and cloud environments
 Document data flows, interfaces, dependencies, and technical decisions
 Collaborate with mission, engineering, security, and stakeholder teams on practical implementation
 Apply secure coding and automated testing best practices throughout development
 Help safeguard sensitive, proprietary, CUI, or classified information as required
 Work effectively within secure, government, or defense-oriented environments
 
 What You'll Need:
 Hands-on experience in data engineering, data integration, or software engineering
 Experience building ETL pipelines and data processing workflows
 Experience integrating APIs, applications, services, or databases
 Proficiency in a modern programming language — Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript
 Working knowledge of cloud-native data platforms and services
 Experience developing or troubleshooting in Linux-based environments
 Familiarity with Git and collaborative source control workflows
 Understanding of secure coding and software engineering best practices
 Strong troubleshooting skills across pipelines, APIs, databases, and integrations
 Solid analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
 Ability to collaborate across engineering teams and adapt to shifting requirements
 Ability to work within secure or mission-oriented environments
 
 Nice to Have:
 Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services
 Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms
 Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD tools
 Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases
 Experience with data modeling, large-scale processing, or streaming/event-driven architectures
 Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization tools
 Exposure to DevOps/DevSecOps practices
 Experience assessing software dependencies, licensing, or supply chain security
 Background supporting federal, defense, intelligence, or other mission-driven organizations
 AWS certification (Developer, Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, or DevOps Engineer)
 Active or eligible security clearance, where applicable
 
 Security Clearance Requirement: 
An active Secret security clearance is required for this position.​ 
 
This position is part of our Federal Solutions team. 
 
The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now. 
 
Salary Range: $112,200.00 - $196,400.00 
 
 
 
We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle! 
 
 
 
 
 
Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. 
 
We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY! 
 Parsons is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices. To learn more about recruitment fraud and how to report it, please refer to   https://www.parsons.com/fraudulent-recruitment/ .
